name: Friendbuy
description: Friendbuy is a referral and loyalty platform for customer acquisition, personalized referral links, purchases, signups, rewards, campaigns, analytics, and privacy workflows.
agentUseSummary: Friendbuy cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its Merchant API requires customer-specific access and secret keys provisioned by Friendbuy Support, exchanges them for a twenty-minute bearer token, and publishes no granular permission scopes; representative account, credential, and lifecycle acceptance is required first.

blocked.label: Collect Friendbuy credentials
blocked.description: Relay does not collect support-issued merchant credentials before representative account and lifecycle acceptance.

blocked.label: Exchange for a bearer token
blocked.description: No live authorization exchange occurs before credentials, expiry, retry, and denial behavior are accepted.

blocked.label: Read Friendbuy data
blocked.description: Customers, email captures, purchases, referrals, campaigns, rewards, analytics, and privacy records remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Mutate or use raw Friendbuy APIs
blocked.description: Customer, purchase, signup, event, referral-link, privacy deletion, arbitrary endpoints, pagination, and raw responses are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Friendbuy action is enabled before support-provisioned credential and representative authority acceptance.

No Friendbuy wrappers are mounted until a representative merchant establishes the frozen support-issued credential contract.

providerSetup.blocker: Friendbuy instructs merchants to contact Support for a private access key and secret, then exchange that pair for a bearer token expiring after twenty minutes. The published Merchant API has no resource scopes and spans customer creation, purchases, signups, events, referral links, analytics, GDPR/CCPA retrieval and deletion, while public documentation does not establish credential rotation or revocation.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative Friendbuy merchant, have its Customer Success Manager or Support provision dedicated Merchant API credentials without exposing them in reports, store them in Railway, and return exact-account binding, key rotation and revocation, token expiry and retry, schema, quota, privacy-redaction, denial, and disconnect evidence before implementation.

evidence.supports: Friendbuy documents a Merchant API whose access and secret keys are obtained from Support and exchanged at /v1/authorization for a bearer token expiring after twenty minutes; the surface includes customer, purchase, signup, referral-link, analytics, and GDPR/CCPA operations.
Friendbuy states private API keys must be obtained from the customer's Customer Success Manager or Support before the bearer-token exchange.
Friendbuy documents API-backed privacy access and deletion workflows, confirming the merchant authority includes sensitive personal data and destructive privacy operations.
